scenarios.title: A｜回复晚了
scenarios.setting: 玩家发现朋友昨天发来的消息自己一直没回。

turns.prompt: 你想为刚才的情况致歉或作些说明，会怎么说？

choices.text: Sorry for the late reply! Yesterday got really busy.

feedback.naturalExpression: Sorry for the late reply! Yesterday got really busy.
feedback.explanation: 点明自己为什么致歉，比只说一句“sorry”更能让对方知道问题已被理解。

choices.text: Sorry, I just realized I never replied to this.

feedback.naturalExpression: Sorry, I just realized I never replied to this.
feedback.explanation: “Sorry”可用于礼貌打断或引出更正，后面的具体内容让对方知道需要回应哪一点。

choices.text: So sorry for taking forever to get back to you.

feedback.naturalExpression: So sorry for taking forever to get back to you.
feedback.explanation: “taking forever”夸张表示拖了很久，“get back to you”指回复对方，适合口语化致歉。

choices.text: Sorry! I saw your message yesterday and completely forgot to reply.

feedback.naturalExpression: Sorry! I saw your message yesterday and completely forgot to reply.
feedback.explanation: “Sorry”可用于礼貌打断或引出更正，后面的具体内容让对方知道需要回应哪一点。

choices.text: Sorry for reply you so late.

feedback.naturalExpression: Sorry for the late reply! Yesterday got really busy.
feedback.explanation: “for”后接“replying”；“reply”接人还需“to”，如“Sorry for replying so late”。

turns.text: Haha no worries. I figured you were busy.

turns.prompt: 你想在解释回复较晚后，关心事情的后续，会怎么说？

choices.text: Yeah, it was a crazy day. Anyway, how did it go?

feedback.naturalExpression: Yeah, it was a crazy day. Anyway, how did it go?
feedback.explanation: “how did”询问过去事件的方式或时间，已有“did”后动词用原形。

choices.text: Thanks for understanding! So, what ended up happening?

feedback.naturalExpression: Thanks for understanding! So, what ended up happening?
feedback.explanation: “ended up”表示最终结果，常用于说明事情后来发展成了什么样。

choices.text: Yeah 😭 I’m finally catching up on messages now.

feedback.naturalExpression: Yeah 😭 I’m finally catching up on messages now.
feedback.explanation: 直接交代自己当前的状态或安排，能让对方据此继续交流。

scenarios.title: B｜忘记某件事
scenarios.setting: 玩家答应给朋友带一本书，见面前突然想起来自己忘了。

turns.prompt: 你想为刚才的情况致歉或作些说明，会怎么说？

choices.text: I’m so sorry—I completely forgot to bring your book.

feedback.naturalExpression: I’m so sorry—I completely forgot to bring your book.
feedback.explanation: 直接交代自己当前的状态或安排，能让对方据此继续交流。

choices.text: I just realized I left your book at home. Sorry!

feedback.naturalExpression: I just realized I left your book at home. Sorry!
feedback.explanation: “at home”表示在家，聊日常安排时可以简洁交代地点。

choices.text: This is embarrassing, but I totally forgot about the book.

feedback.naturalExpression: This is embarrassing, but I totally forgot about the book.
feedback.explanation: 先交代一部分情况，再补充限制或不同之处，避免对方只根据前半句作判断。

choices.text: Sorry! I’ll bring it next time, I promise.

feedback.naturalExpression: Sorry! I’ll bring it next time, I promise.
feedback.explanation: “next time”把可能的参与留到下次，适合婉拒当下的邀请。

choices.text: I forgot your book at home.

feedback.assessment: 可以理解，但还可以更自然
feedback.naturalExpression: I’m so sorry—I completely forgot to bring your book.
feedback.explanation: 把书落在家里用“left your book at home”；“forgot”更常接忘带或忘做的动作。

turns.text: Haha, it’s fine. I don’t need it urgently.

turns.prompt: 关于「道歉」，你想说明自己接下来能做什么或打算怎么做，会怎么说？

choices.text: Thanks 😭 I’ll bring it tomorrow.

feedback.naturalExpression: Thanks 😭 I’ll bring it tomorrow.
feedback.explanation: “will”在这里交代接下来的决定或行动，让对方知道自己会怎样继续。

choices.text: Sorry again. I’ll set a reminder this time.

feedback.naturalExpression: Sorry again. I’ll set a reminder this time.
feedback.explanation: “will”在这里交代接下来的决定或行动，让对方知道自己会怎样继续。

choices.text: Thanks for understanding. I feel so bad.

feedback.naturalExpression: Thanks for understanding. I feel so bad.
feedback.explanation: 从自己的感受说明影响，把需要讨论的重点说出来，避免直接替对方判断动机。

scenarios.title: C｜临时改变计划
scenarios.setting: 玩家临时发现自己要晚半小时。

turns.prompt: 你想为临时变动致歉，并商量新的见面时间，会怎么说？

choices.text: Sorry for the last-minute change, but could we meet at 7:30 instead?

feedback.naturalExpression: Sorry for the last-minute change, but could we meet at 7:30 instead?
feedback.explanation: 用时间短语标明时点或持续时长，让对方能据此安排，而不只知道一个模糊的“晚点”。

choices.text: I’m really sorry, but I’m running late. Would 7:30 still work?

feedback.naturalExpression: I’m really sorry, but I’m running late. Would 7:30 still work?
feedback.explanation: “running late”表示会比原定时间晚到；补充预计迟到多久，更方便对方调整安排。

choices.text: Sorry for the short notice—something came up.

feedback.naturalExpression: Sorry for the short notice—something came up.
feedback.explanation: “something came up”在临时安排中表示出现了事情，常用于简短解释为什么要改约。

choices.text: I hate to change plans this late, but I need another half hour.

feedback.naturalExpression: I hate to change plans this late, but I need another half hour.
feedback.explanation: 直接说明必要的需求，便于对方了解要解决什么；配合具体内容，比只说需要帮忙更清楚。

choices.text: Sorry, I suddenly have something.

feedback.assessment: 可以理解，但还可以更自然
feedback.naturalExpression: Sorry for the last-minute change, but could we meet at 7:30 instead?
feedback.explanation: 临时有事常说“Something came up”；“suddenly have something”有直译感。

turns.prompt: 你想为刚才的情况致歉或作些说明，会怎么说？

choices.text: Thank you! Sorry again.

feedback.naturalExpression: Thank you! Sorry again.
feedback.explanation: 用简短感谢接住对方的帮助或答复，表示已经收到这份好意。

choices.text: You’re the best. I’ll see you at 7:30.

feedback.naturalExpression: You’re the best. I’ll see you at 7:30.
feedback.explanation: 用时间短语标明时点或持续时长，让对方能据此安排，而不只知道一个模糊的“晚点”。

choices.text: Thanks for being flexible. I’ll text you when I’m close.

feedback.naturalExpression: Thanks for being flexible. I’ll text you when I’m close.
feedback.explanation: “will”在这里交代接下来的决定或行动，让对方知道自己会怎样继续。
